what: ablation ladder on both camera families + the regularisation audit

verdict.claim: the L2/curvature penalty is INERT: it never exceeds a fraction of a percent of the data loss, so it cannot explain a rung-to-rung difference of any size that this project measures.
verdict.not_commensurable: z_weights is in units of the scene radius (config.py:208), theta/phi_weights in radians; camera_opt_reg_l2 = 1e-2 is applied to both, so equal coefficients are NOT equal physical pressure. Harmless only because the whole term is inert.

conventions.fisheye_metric: masked PSNR at r=0.95, per-view mean (collect/rungs.py)
conventions.never_pooled: the two families are never averaged together; only deltas vs each scene's own `off` are compared, and only qualitatively.
conventions.n: n = 1 run per cell, no seeds. Any |delta| below 0.068 dB is a zero.
